findings.title: Pass the user to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled
findings.body: This calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` without arguments, but the helper added to `UsernamePasswordForm` requires a `UserModel` argument. No matching zero-argument method exists, so `UsernameForm` does not compile and the services build is blocked.

findings.title: Do not require an identified user to enable conditional passkeys
findings.body: The new helper returns false whenever `user` is null, which is the normal state when initially displaying a login form. Both `authenticate()` and the error-challenge path now use this helper, so they no longer call `fillContextForm()` for ordinary login. Consequently, conditional passkey UI and its WebAuthn challenge are absent until a user has already been identified; discoverable-key login stops working, and passkey-only users cannot sign in through these forms. Keep passkeys enabled for unidentified users as well as during re-authentication.
